reviewCoverage.identity: Exact protected Nautica record covers Nautica One and Nautica Two. Issuer launch release confirms two identical towers with 328 apartments each; not two separate canonical projects.
reviewCoverage.location: Own main page explicitly Dubai Maritime City, between Port Rashid and Dubai Drydocks World. Exact existing registry area used, no invented coordinates or promised views.
reviewCoverage.residences: Own current specifications and eight visually inspected branded drawings confirm one- and two-bedroom apartments. PF narrative studio claim excluded. Both towers share the same published drawings.
reviewCoverage.areas: All eight fäm-hosted branded plan panels visually inspected at 1700px, including both mirrored A and B variants. Six unique type families entered once, both unit numbers retained. All internal plus balcony sums match; both metric and imperial printed totals retained. Typical-floorplate levels 7–24 and 26–48 only, not every selected unit.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Own current list and brochure leisure podium panel checked: infinity pool, jacuzzi, pool deck, changing facilities, three gym areas, yoga lawn, basketball and padel. No invented beach access, furnishing or parking allocation.
reviewCoverage.pricing: No current official unit price found. PF separate sold-out pages show exact historical references 1,565,762 and 1,683,844; rounded hero prices differ only in display precision. Launch reference does not establish resale or developer stock.
reviewCoverage.payment: Own FAQ and visually inspected brochure payment panel confirm AED50,000 reservation followed by balance of initial20% within14 days, another20% within6 months and60% completion. Three aggregate stages sum100; deposit is included, not an extra payment. No arbitrary booking date or fees invented.

overview: Nautica One and Nautica Two share the same published apartment designs. The developer’s original launch specified 328 apartments per tower.
research.locationNote: Dubai Maritime City, between Port Rashid and Dubai Drydocks World.
research.priceLabel: Historical portal launch reference · not current availability
research.priceNote: Property Finder lists AED 1,565,762 for Nautica One and AED 1,683,844 for Nautica Two. Both pages mark developer stock sold out; these are reference prices, not current offers.
research.paymentNote: AED 50,000 reserves a home and forms part of the initial 20%. The published schedule totals 100%; obtain the applicable contract and charges.
research.handoverNote: The developer still states 2026; its September 2023 launch targeted Q4 2026, matching Property Finder. Completion has not been independently certified.
